blocks.hero.eyebrow: Louisville, KY · Middletown office and online
blocks.hero.subhead: Freedom Counseling Services is a Louisville counseling practice in Middletown, just off Blankenbaker Parkway. Meet your counselor in our office or online, and switch between the two whenever you need to.

facts.text: Choose your counselor, or let us match you

blocks.request.heading: Ready to meet your Louisville counselor?
blocks.request.text: Request an appointment in about a minute, or call (502) 523-2970. Most people are seen the same week.

sections.heading: Counseling that fits into a Louisville week
sections.body:
The best counselor for you won't help much if getting there is a struggle. Our office is a short drive for most of eastern Louisville, and on the weeks you can't make the drive, you can meet online instead. You never have to choose between the counselor you want and a schedule that works.

Clients come to us from Middletown, St. Matthews, Jeffersontown, Anchorage, Lyndon, Prospect, and across eastern Louisville.

blocks.links.heading: What Louisville clients come to us for

links.items.title: Individual counseling
links.items.text: For anxiety, depression, OCD, or a season of feeling stuck

links.items.title: Christian counseling
links.items.text: For anyone who wants faith at the center

blocks.faith.heading: Faith at the center, never forced
blocks.faith.body: Freedom brings together a biblical worldview, Christian theology, and the best clinical practice. If you'd rather not bring faith into your counseling, you'll get the same excellent care, and your counselor will follow your lead.
blocks.team.heading: Your Louisville counselors
blocks.team.note: Every counselor is accepting new clients and meets in person or online.

more.heading: In person, online, or both
more.body: Every counselor meets in our Middletown office or online. Many clients mix the two: in person when it's easy, online during a busy week. You can switch anytime, no special permission needed.

blocks.office.heading: Finding our office
blocks.office.directions: We're just off Blankenbaker Parkway, across from Southeast Christian Church, in the office complex behind Heine Brothers Coffee. Parking is right outside.
blocks.expect.heading: Your first visit
blocks.expect.body: Your first session is mostly a conversation: your counselor getting to know you and what brought you in. There's nothing to prepare. Sessions are 50 minutes.
blocks.cost.heading: What it costs
blocks.cost.body: We don't bill insurance, but we'll give you a superbill to submit for possible out-of-network reimbursement.
